files.Title: ShapeEngine.Core.TriangleBatch
files.Summary:
A class for efficient triangle drawing using Raylib's RLGL, supporting both persistent batches and immediate-mode drawing.

This class serves two main purposes:

  • Pooled Instances: obtain an instance via to manage a persistent list of vertices. This is ideal for static geometry that doesn't change often. The batch can be drawn repeatedly with . Remember to return it to the pool with when finished.
  • Immediate Mode (Static): use static methods like , , and for dynamic, per-frame triangle drawing without managing a specific object instance.

Both approaches utilize , meaning every 3 consecutive vertices form a single triangle.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.ShapeClipper.ShapeClipper2D
files.Summary: Provides shared Clipper-backed 2D geometry utilities and configuration for path extraction, clipping, offsetting, shape creation, simplification, winding analysis, and hole filtering.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.ShapeClipper.ShapeClipper64
files.Summary: Provides reusable helpers for performing boolean clipping operations on Clipper and geometry, as well as engine polygon data represented by lists.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.ShapeClipper.ShapeClipperClipType
files.Summary: Specifies the boolean clipping operation to apply when combining shapes.

files.Summary: Provides Clipper/world-space conversion helpers for 2D paths, polygons, rectangles, points, and related enums.

files.Summary: Provides immediate-style drawing helpers for polygons and polylines backed by ShapeClipper triangulation.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.ShapeClipper.ShapeClipperEndType
files.Summary: The ShapeClipperEndType enumerator controls how the ends of paths are handled when performing offset (inflating/shrinking) operations. This enumeration is only required for offset operations and is not used for polygon clipping.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.ShapeClipper.ShapeClipperFillRule
files.Summary: Filling rules determine which sub-regions of complex polygons are considered "inside". Complex polygons are defined by one or more closed contours; only portions of these contours may contribute to filled regions, so a filling rule is required to decide which sub-regions are treated as inside when performing clipping operations.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.ShapeClipper.ShapeClipperJoinType
files.Summary: Specifies how convex angled joins are handled when offsetting (inflating/shrinking) paths. This enumeration is only required for offset operations (e.g. ClipperOffset) and is not used for polygon clipping operations.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.ShapeClipper.ShapeClipperOffset
files.Summary: Wraps a instance to offset polygons and polylines using the engine's world-space coordinate conventions.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.ShapeClipper.ShapeClipperTriangulation2D
files.Summary: Provides Clipper-backed triangulation helpers for polygons, polygon outlines, and polyline strokes in 2D.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.ShapeClipper.TriMesh
files.Summary: Represents a mutable triangle mesh stored as a flat vertex buffer.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.ShapeClipper.TriMeshPool
files.Summary: Provides a simple reusable pool of instances to reduce allocations during repeated triangulation work.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.StaticLib.PerlinNoise2D
files.Summary: Provides 2D Perlin noise generation utilities. Produces smooth, continuous noise values (approximately in the range [-1, 1]) for given world coordinates scaled by a lattice cell size (gridSize). Maintains a static cache of pseudo-random gradient vectors and exposes an integer Seed to change the generated gradients. Changing Seed clears the gradient cache.
